criteria.description: Phase 1's finding on the premise is recorded in the QA report.
criteria.note: A documentation criterion. The cited section 'Phase 1 finding (premise)' (qa.1 lines 18-20) states that the filed premise was wrong in part (a validator that accepts a hostile value is already counted as reproduced) and records the design choice. Line 41 of the same report repeats it as 'Premise finding recorded | PASS'. No test pins the QA report text.

criteria.description: Entry form with a stated limit yields observation_limits in record and DoD Probe Results line.
criteria.code_citation: shared/resources/security-probe.mjs:4349 (record entry); shared/resources/security-probe.mjs:4682 (block print); shared/resources/security-probe-plan.mjs:593 (plan output); skills/finalise/SKILL.md:1125-1126 (Probe Results line)
criteria.note: Lane: shared/resources/tests/*.test.mjs and evals/shared/tests/*.test.mjs are both globbed by test:suite, which runs under `npm test` in .github/workflows/test.yml:58 on the PR. Test 9715 asserts the ids on each control and the sentences once in the security_review block. Test 9768 asserts the plan output carries observation_limits. The finalise pin at :1002 covers the DoD line.

criteria.description: Every form carries the universal limit; only fence: adds the form-specific one; counts unchanged.
criteria.note: Runs in the same `npm test` lane as #2. Test 9693 covers 5 non-fence forms (each returns only effects-after-accept), fence: (adds outside-sandbox-write) and a null entry (still carries the universal limit). Test 9746 strips the field and asserts the emitted block and probes_executed: 6 are identical. All entry forms listed in the test are mapped.

criteria.description: No extra probe executions: the test counts the runs.
criteria.code_citation: shared/resources/security-probe.mjs:4349 (the field is derived from the entry string only; no execution path is added)
criteria.note: Test 9768 asserts out.probes_executed equals rec.totals.executed after the field is stripped, and test 9746 asserts probes_executed: 6 with and without the field. Both run per-PR under `npm test`. The assertion compares the count with and without the field; it is not an absolute run counter. Combined with the diff (observationLimitsFor takes only the entry string) it supports the criterion, so I judged it PASS.

Process-style criterion: it names three commands the work must pass, and its evidence is the committed QA records, not only CI state. qa.1:45 records ci:fast TEST_EXIT=0 on the LAN server at develop and bundle:check at 129 skills, 0 problems. qa.2:85 records the remote ci:fast at qa-fix (TEST_EXIT=0, 8450 pass, 0 fail, on the tree that became 88ddf934), and its commands section lists `npm run bundle:check` with 129 skills, 0 problems. pr-review.2:36 repeats this. ci:fast is `npm run format:check && npm test` (package.json:25), so the format:check half is covered by it. Units are the two phases (develop, qa-fix); both have a recorded result naming the command and the outcome.

criteria.description: CHANGELOG.md entry; readers of the record tolerate the new field.
criteria.note: CHANGELOG half (documentation criterion): lines 9-20, read, are an [Unreleased] 'Added' entry that cites (task 300) and describes the observation_limits field and says it is additive. evals/shared/tests/changelog-entry-drift.test.mjs guards that each accepted task is cited under [Unreleased]; it runs in the evals/shared/tests/*.test.mjs glob of `npm test`. Tolerance half (behaviour): test 9746 reads a record written before the field existed and asserts the same limit texts, the same counts and an identical block once the field is stripped. It runs per-PR under `npm test` (.github/workflows/test.yml:58).

advisories.note: The criterion text in the task file carries an appended note ('every form but fence:' and 'Held by the same test'). criteria-drift.js returned reason: clean, changed: [], exit 0, so no amendment is unapproved.

No test asserts an absolute run count or that the new code adds no execution; the evidence is equality of probes_executed with and without the field plus the diff. Consider a stricter assertion if the criterion is tightened.
